The Conversation

⭐Part 1: 🕰️ Past Stories From Real Life

🕰️ From Life. me the you Starter: This I had to ___ ___. Follow-ups: Where were you? What you you? What would you do Helpful I it by. I for It was but I will.

Question: Tell me about the last small problem you solved.

Follow-ups

  • Where were you?
  • What did you try first?
  • Did anyone help you?
  • What would you do faster next time?

Starter

This week, I had to solve ___ because ___.

Helpful expressions

I fixed it by...

I asked for help.

It was annoying, but okay.

Next time, I will...

⭐Part 2: 🕰️ Past Stories From Real Life

🕰️ From Life. me the your Starter: I to ___, but ___. Follow-ups: Why the Was the or How you at What was your Helpful My I had to It out in the I a

Question: Tell me about the last time your plan changed.

Follow-ups

  • Why did the plan change?
  • Was the new plan better or worse?
  • How did you feel at first?
  • What was your plan B?

Starter

I planned to ___, but then ___.

Helpful expressions

My plan changed.

I had to wait.

It worked out in the end.

I needed a backup plan.

⭐Part 3: 🕰️ Past Stories From Real Life

🕰️ From Life. What was you Starter: I ___, but I when ___. Follow-ups: Why was it easy to What you remember? What would have if you How can you remember Helpful at the I a I to be careful.

Question: What was one thing you almost forgot recently?

Follow-ups

  • Why was it easy to forget?
  • What helped you remember?
  • What would have happened if you forgot?
  • How can you remember next time?

Starter

I almost forgot ___, but I remembered when ___.

Helpful expressions

at the last minute

luckily

I set a reminder.

I need to be more careful.

⭐Part 4: 🕰️ Past Stories From Real Life

🕰️ From Life. What or was the money Starter: I ___, and it was ___. Follow-ups: Where you it? Was it or Would you it Who would you it to? Helpful It was but The was I would it I it for.

Question: What food or drink was worth the money recently?

Follow-ups

  • Where did you buy it?
  • Was it cheap, normal, or expensive?
  • Would you buy it again?
  • Who would you recommend it to?

Starter

Recently, I bought ___, and it was worth it because ___.

Helpful expressions

It was simple but good.

The price was fair.

I would buy it again.

I recommend it for...

⭐Part 5: 🕰️ Past Stories From Real Life

🕰️ From Life. me a message you or Starter: I a message ___, so I ___. Follow-ups: Who it? Was it or you What will Helpful I I It was a surprising. I will

Question: Tell me about a message you sent or received recently.

Follow-ups

  • Who sent it?
  • Was it good news, bad news, or normal news?
  • Did you reply quickly?
  • What will happen next?

Starter

Recently, I got a message about ___, so I ___.

Helpful expressions

I replied right away.

I needed more information.

It was a little surprising.

I will check again later.

⭐Part 6: 🕰️ Past Stories From Real Life

🕰️ From Life. me the you for Starter: I for ___ for ___. Follow-ups: Where were you What you do you Was the or long? What would Helpful in for I a message. It than it was.

Question: Tell me about the last time you waited for something.

Follow-ups

  • Where were you waiting?
  • What did you do while you waited?
  • Was the wait okay or too long?
  • What would make waiting easier?

Starter

I waited for ___ for about ___.

Helpful expressions

in line

for about ten minutes

I read a message.

It felt longer than it was.

⭐Part 7: 📅 Future Plans And Plan B

📅 And What is you to do this weekend? Starter: this weekend, I to ___. Follow-ups: Why do you to do it? When will you do it? What you? What is the Helpful I to I do it The is. If I am I will.

Question: What is one practical thing you need to do before this weekend?

Follow-ups

  • Why do you need to do it?
  • When will you do it?
  • What might stop you?
  • What is the first small step?

Starter

Before this weekend, I need to ___.

Helpful expressions

I need to finish...

I should do it before...

The first step is...

If I am busy, I will...

⭐Part 8: 📅 Future Plans And Plan B

📅 And What you do on your free Starter: On my free I ___. Follow-ups: Will you stay or out? Who you What will you do if it What would it a Helpful If the weather is If I I keep it I have not yet.

Question: What might you do on your next free afternoon?

Follow-ups

  • Will you stay home or go out?
  • Who might you invite?
  • What will you do if it rains?
  • What would make it a perfect afternoon?

Starter

On my next free afternoon, I might ___.

Helpful expressions

If the weather is good...

If I feel tired...

I might keep it simple.

I have not decided yet.

⭐Part 9: 📅 Future Plans And Plan B

📅 And What event, or do you to remember soon? Starter: Soon, I to remember ___ on ___. Follow-ups: How will you remember it? Do you to What you What will if you are late? Helpful I it in my I early. I to I it.

Question: What appointment, event, or plan do you need to remember soon?

Follow-ups

  • How will you remember it?
  • Do you need to prepare anything?
  • What time should you arrive?
  • What will happen if you are late?

Starter

Soon, I need to remember ___ on ___.

Helpful expressions

I put it in my calendar.

I should arrive early.

I need to prepare...

I cannot forget it.

⭐Part 10: 📅 Future Plans And Plan B

📅 And What is you to for the Starter: I to ___ ___. Follow-ups: When you it? Who you it with? What it interesting? What are you a Helpful for the I am It I am a

Question: What is one small thing you want to try for the first time?

Follow-ups

  • When might you try it?
  • Who could you try it with?
  • What makes it interesting?
  • What are you a little worried about?

Starter

I want to try ___ because ___.

Helpful expressions

for the first time

I am curious about...

It looks fun.

I am a little nervous.

⭐Part 11: 📅 Future Plans And Plan B

📅 And What message do you to soon? Starter: Soon, I to a message to ___ ___. Follow-ups: Is it easy or to write? What do you to the message be or What answer do you hope to Helpful I to we the let me you for your

Question: What message do you need to send soon?

Follow-ups

  • Is it easy or difficult to write?
  • What information do you need to include?
  • Should the message be friendly or formal?
  • What answer do you hope to get?

Starter

Soon, I need to send a message to ___ about ___.

Helpful expressions

I need to ask about...

Could we change the time?

Please let me know.

Thank you for your help.

⭐Part 12: 📅 Future Plans And Plan B

📅 And If what will you move or Starter: If I will move ___ to ___. Follow-ups: What is What can Who do you to How will you if the Helpful I can move. I can The is. I will early.

Question: If tomorrow suddenly becomes busy, what will you move or cancel?

Follow-ups

  • What is most important tomorrow?
  • What can wait?
  • Who do you need to tell?
  • How will you feel if the plan changes?

Starter

If tomorrow becomes busy, I will move ___ to ___.

Helpful expressions

I can move...

I can cancel...

The most important thing is...

I will tell someone early.

⭐Part 13: 🧰 Practical Conversation Branches

🧰 Branches. You are late. What do you Starter: sorry late. ___ but I am here Follow-ups: What Was it your or not? What can you to How can you it Helpful Sorry for being late. The was I late. you for

Question: You are ten minutes late. What do you say?

Follow-ups

  • What happened?
  • Was it your fault or not?
  • What can you say to sound polite?
  • How can you avoid it next time?

Starter

I'm sorry I'm late. ___ happened, but I am here now.

Helpful expressions

Sorry for being late.

The train was delayed.

I left too late.

Thank you for waiting.

⭐Part 14: 🧰 Practical Conversation Branches

🧰 Branches. A shop or restaurant a What do you do? Starter: me, I there is a with ___. Follow-ups: What is the Do you money a or How can you it What will you do if they it? Helpful I I this is not mine. you it? No you.

Question: A shop or restaurant made a small mistake. What do you do?

Follow-ups

  • What is the mistake?
  • Do you want money back, a new item, or just help?
  • How can you say it kindly?
  • What will you do if they cannot fix it?

Starter

Excuse me, I think there is a small mistake with ___.

Helpful expressions

I ordered...

I think this is not mine.

Could you check it?

No problem, thank you.

⭐Part 15: 🧰 Practical Conversation Branches

🧰 Branches. You to a with What do you Starter: we the from ___ to ___? Follow-ups: Why do you to it? What for you? What if the person is How can you sorry but Helpful up. Does ___ for you? Sorry for the I it.

Question: You need to change a time with someone. What do you say?

Follow-ups

  • Why do you need to change it?
  • What new time works for you?
  • What if the other person is busy?
  • How can you sound sorry but clear?

Starter

Could we change the time from ___ to ___?

Helpful expressions

Something came up.

Does ___ work for you?

Sorry for the change.

I appreciate it.

⭐Part 16: 🧰 Practical Conversation Branches

🧰 Branches. You do not an What do you Starter: Sorry, you ___ Follow-ups: Which is Do you an Do you to you? What will you do you Helpful you that Can you me? Do you ___? I

Question: You do not understand an instruction. What do you ask?

Follow-ups

  • Which part is confusing?
  • Do you need an example?
  • Do you need someone to show you?
  • What will you do after you understand?

Starter

Sorry, could you explain ___ again?

Helpful expressions

Could you say that again?

Can you show me?

Do you mean ___?

I understand now.

⭐Part 17: 🧰 Practical Conversation Branches

🧰 Branches. You but the person What do you Starter: me, do you have a I with ___. Follow-ups: Why do you Can you or is it What do you How will you the person? Helpful Do you have a It is not When you have that a

Question: You need help, but the other person looks busy. What do you say?

Follow-ups

  • Why do you need help?
  • Can you wait, or is it urgent?
  • What exact help do you need?
  • How will you thank the person?

Starter

Excuse me, do you have a minute? I need help with ___.

Helpful expressions

Do you have a minute?

It is not urgent.

When you have time...

Thanks, that helps a lot.

⭐Part 18: 🎲 Fun But Useful Branches

🎲 But Branches. What photo from this a Starter: A photo from this ___, and the is ___. Follow-ups: Where was the photo Who or what is in it? Why you it? What or the photo? Helpful I it It me of. that. that.

Question: What photo from this week could become a small story?

Follow-ups

  • Where was the photo taken?
  • Who or what is in it?
  • Why did you take it?
  • What happened before or after the photo?

Starter

Helpful expressions

I took it because...

It reminds me of...

Before that...

After that...

⭐Part 19: 🎲 Fun But Useful Branches

🎲 But Branches. What near you has a Starter: This ___ has a ___. Follow-ups: When you it? Do you it Would you the What would you do if you it? Helpful I it I it from. It is I would it.

Question: What object near you has a small story?

Follow-ups

  • Do you use it often?
  • Would you buy the same one again?
  • What would you do if you lost it?

Starter

This ___ has a small story because ___.

Helpful expressions

I use it almost every day.

I got it from...

It is useful because...

I would miss it.

Question: If your week had a weather report, what would it be?

Follow-ups

  • What was the sunny part?
  • What was the cloudy part?
  • Did anything feel stormy?
  • What weather do you want next week?

Starter

Helpful expressions

sunny

cloudy

windy

a little stormy

calm and warm

Follow-ups

  • When do you usually enjoy it?
  • Do you share it with anyone?
  • Did you have it recently?
  • Would you recommend it to a tired friend?

Starter

Helpful expressions

⭐Part 22: 🎲 Fun But Useful Branches

🎲 But Branches. If you had free hours what would you do? Starter: If I had free hours I would ___. Follow-ups: Would you or do Would you alone or with What would you not do? How would you that? Helpful I would I would I would not on. I would

Question: If you had two free hours tomorrow, what would you do?

Follow-ups

  • Would you relax or do something useful?
  • Would you go alone or with someone?
  • What would you definitely not do?
  • How would you feel after that?

Starter

Helpful expressions

I would probably...

I would finally...

I would not waste time on...

💡Key IdeaOpen

A natural conversation grows from one real detail.

Ask about time, place, reason, feeling, result, or the next plan.

If the answer is short, make the next question more concrete.
